note: Each case calls LinkHeaderParser.FindNext(header) on the already-joined value of every Link header instance; expected is the raw URI-reference between the angle brackets of the first link-value whose first rel parameter lists the token next (case-insensitive), or null. The first 15 cases are the 15 Node cases (the array-of-instances ones are joined with a comma, as the strategy joins them); the rest are the .NET-specific cases of phase 7c. Resolution of the reference is LinkTargetTests, not this file: Node follows a target that is not a URL as a relative path, this port ends the stream there. Node reads every rel parameter of a link-value, this port reads only the first (RFC 8288 section 3.3).
